explanation: Variant of erdosproblems.com/1042, first question ('can {|f| < 1} have n connected components?') read universally over F: for every closed F of transfinite diameter 1 not contained in a closed disc of radius 1, there are infinitely many n admitting a monic degree-n polynomial with roots in F and n components. The page records only the existential resolution (examples exist), so presenting the universal version as a separate open question is appropriate and clearly documented, including why 'infinitely many n' rather than 'some n' is needed. Correctly formalised with the same definitions as the main statement.
